title: ZuCo 2.0: EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading and Annotation
description: ZuCo 2.0 provides simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recordings from adult native English speakers reading natural Wikipedia sentences. Two paradigms are included: normal reading and task-specific reading with annotation of semantic relations. The data are organized in BIDS with gaze and pupil samples as physiological recordings and fixations, saccades and blinks as events.
methods_description: 128-channel EEG was recorded with an EGI Geodesic system (500 Hz, Cz reference) simultaneously with EyeLink 1000 eye-tracking (500 Hz, left eye). Participants read sentences in blocks, each block being a run, in normal reading and task-specific reading tasks. Recordings were made at the University of Zurich.
